Here $i\Omega$ is a bosonic Matsubara frequency, so that $e^{i\Omega\beta} = 1$. The imaginary-time integral of the bubble gives
\begin{equation}
\int_0^{\beta} d\tau\, e^{i\Omega\tau} e^{-\epsilon\tau} = \frac{e^{-\beta\epsilon}-1}{i\Omega-\epsilon} .
\label{eq:bub}
\end{equation}
